head_commit.message:
Lessons: find each gameweek's mistakes and keep a memory the next plan reads (#54)

* Lessons: find each gameweek's mistakes and keep a memory the next plan reads

After a gameweek the new lessons step looks at your real team and the bot's recorded
decisions: transfers you had to make yourself, moves the bot held that paid at once,
captain, bench order, goalkeeper, hits that lost and field-core hauls you missed. Each
mistake is stored with its cost and its lesson. Before the next plan the memory turns
recent lessons into small capped switches (banked transfers worth less and a lower bar for
this week's moves after held moves paid; a higher bar for hits after one lost) that fade
unless the mistake repeats, and scales the projections of the top-10k's core by what they
scored against what was projected. Decisions now record the next weeks' planned moves and
the captain shortlist so the review can see what was held.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01TAZs854XWUUXxUiuRhT3A7

* Decide: the robustness bar defaults to the module setting at call time
